DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_ElecPanda:
Can be ridden.
While mounted, increases it's and the player's Defense stat by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>, reduces own active skill cooldowns by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>, and can fire a minigun while mounted.

<Status_Keyword>Impervious</>: Cannot be <Status_Keyword>flinched</>, <Status_Keyword>knocked back</> or <Status_Keyword>stunned</>.
